items.title: Datura sold as food online: Karnataka suspends Amazon, Swiggy, BigBasket licences
items.summary: Follow TNM's WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. The Karnataka Food Safety and Drug Administration Department has suspended the food licences of Amazon, Swiggy Instamart and BigBasket until further orders after toxic Datura fruits and seeds were found being sold online as food products. According to an order issued by Food Safety Commissioner K Srinivas, the department has also directed the three platforms to immediately remove listings and advertisements for Datura, also known as Dhatura, and stop selling or distributing the products for human consumption. Datura, known as jimsonweed or devil’s trumpet, is a highly poisonous plant. It is traditionally used in religious rituals, ornamental gardening and some Ayurvedic practices. The entire plant, including its fruits and seeds, is toxic and can cause severe poisoning and death if consumed. Extremely diluted mixtures of the plant are used in Ayurvedic medicines for various purposes.
